hero.title: Party Up
hero.tagline: Find a table for your tabletop game — the table pulls the players, not the other way around.
pitch.question: There are dozens, maybe hundreds, of dating sites. Why isn't there one for TTRPGs?
pitch.punchline: Find your soulmate? Why not find your tabletop mates?
pitch.body: Party Up flips the model: a player lists themselves on the board and waits, instead of chasing adverts. Tables browse the board and pull whoever they want — the decision sits with the table, and looking for a game stops being a second job.
spread.title: Help the network grow
spread.body: A network like this only works with enough people on both sides. Tell players and game masters about it, share it — the more people join, the easier it is to find a table.
footer.madeWith: Party Up — made with care for tables that pull the players.
